svg.title: Figure 24.1 · Random and strided windows
svg.desc: The held-out split drawn as four source bands, English, Hindi web, Hindi Wikipedia and Python. Eighty random windows (seed 0) fall unevenly across it; eighty strided windows are evenly spaced, so each source receives windows in proportion to its share. Window counts per source are printed below.
svg.text: Where 80 evaluation windows land in the released model's held-out split
data/v2/val.u16, 113.2M tokens, written one source after another · positions computed by train.py
windows per source · random: english 44, hindi_web 32, hindi_wiki 0, python 4 · strided: english 42, hindi_web 33, hindi_wiki 0, python 5
